LanguageData.BasicAnatomy.label: basic anatomy
LanguageData.BasicAnatomy.description: Unlocks bandages, splints and basic fracture and stroke treatments.
LanguageData.BasicFirstAid.label: basic first aid
LanguageData.BasicFirstAid.description: Unlocks tourniquets, blood transfusions and blood collection.
LanguageData.Cpr.label: cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR)
LanguageData.Cpr.description: Unlocks CPR to treat cardiac arrest and blood-obstructed airways. Draft a doctor and right-click the patient to order resuscitation.
LanguageData.AdvancedFirstAid.label: advanced first aid
LanguageData.AdvancedFirstAid.description: Unlocks hemostatic agents for faster, more effective bleeding control than bandages.
LanguageData.MorphineSynthesis.label: morphine synthesis
LanguageData.MorphineSynthesis.description: Unlocks morphine autoinjectors for pain relief. Morphine can impair breathing and resuscitation, especially during severe blood loss.
LanguageData.ChloroformSynthesis.label: chloroform synthesis
LanguageData.ChloroformSynthesis.description: Unlocks chloroform for sedation. Excessive dosing risks overdose and organ damage.
LanguageData.EmergencyMedicine.label: emergency medicine
LanguageData.EmergencyMedicine.description: Unlocks emergency equipment, including defibrillators and airway suction devices.
LanguageData.Neurosurgery.label: neurosurgery
LanguageData.Neurosurgery.description: Unlocks advanced surgery to repair hemorrhagic strokes.
LanguageData.AdvancedThoracicSurgery.label: advanced thoracic surgery
LanguageData.AdvancedThoracicSurgery.description: Unlocks thoracoscopes and advanced collapsed-lung repair.
LanguageData.EpinephrineSynthesis.label: epinephrine synthesis
LanguageData.EpinephrineSynthesis.description: Unlocks epinephrine autoinjectors. Adrenaline temporarily supports shock treatment and boosts movement, but does not replace lost blood.
LanguageData.KetamineSynthesis.label: ketamine synthesis
LanguageData.KetamineSynthesis.description: Unlocks ketamine for pain relief and sedation. Repeated doses can cause dangerous drug buildup and overdose.
LanguageData.CellularRegeneration.label: cellular regenerative medicine
LanguageData.CellularRegeneration.description: Unlocks regenerative treatments for hearing loss, spinal paralysis and neurological damage.
